# Craftmentation instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before making changes, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow its session protocol.
For documentation tasks, explicitly read the [shared workflow policy](../docs/ai-instructions.md),
[README standard](../docs/standard.md), and [library contract](../docs/templates.md).
Use the requested [workflow prompt](../prompts/README.md). These links identify files to
read; they do not imply automatic import or that every Copilot surface loads the same context.

This file is a thin entry point, not a second documentation standard. Report missing
context or unavailable tools instead of assuming the integration is active.
